health.collector_stream_resumed: The event stream resumed. Check separately for gaps during the stall.

health.collector_dropped_lines: Some queued collector events could not be forwarded; coverage has gaps.
health.collector_restarted: The collector instance changed. Streams across the restart are not considered continuous.
health.collector_permission_denied: Collector permission is insufficient. Check Full Disk Access authorization.
health.collector_failed: The collector reported failure. Check system permissions and service status.
health.collector_disconnected: The collector disconnected; current coverage is incomplete.
health.collector_source_unhealthy: The collection source is unhealthy. Check source diagnostics.
health.invalid_run_id: The collector run identifier exceeded the limit; the record was dropped.
health.source_stream_mode_mismatch: The same collector instance mixed legacy single-stream and split-stream protocols.
health.source_version_observed: Actual source versions were observed; missing versions remain unknown.
health.duplicate_event: A duplicate source sequence was observed; the duplicate event was dropped.
health.database_recovered: Evidence writes recovered; some events during the failure were not saved.
health.details_expired: Expired details were removed; cumulative statistics remain. Expired details cannot be fully traced.
health.rules_changed: A new rule version applies to subsequent events; previous counting windows were cleared.
health.retention_changed: Detail retention changed; cumulative statistics and monitoring settings remain independent.
health.monitoring_paused: Monitoring was paused by the user. File activity evidence is incomplete during the pause.
health.monitoring_resumed: Pause intent was cleared. Actual collection health still needs verification.
health.summary_send_failed: Summary notification submission was not confirmed; the pending summary remains for retry.
health.source_timestamp_missing: Source time is missing. Counting windows and alert times fall back to receive time.
health.process_generation_unknown: Process generation is missing. Association does not identify an exact process instance.
health.process_generation_unavailable: Only the process ID is available; exact process instances cannot be distinguished.
health.process_executable_unavailable: The executable path is missing or truncated; process identity coverage is incomplete.
health.event_after_process_exit: Source-time evidence before exit is missing. The exited process window is not extended.
health.source_timestamp_out_of_order: Source times arrived out of order. The maximum watermark is retained and archive correlation uses only earlier access evidence.
health.sequence_gap: An event sequence gap was observed; coverage is incomplete.
health.sequence_regression: Event sequences repeated or regressed. Check the collector instance and ordering.
health.sequence_unavailable: Verifiable event sequences are missing; source continuity cannot be established.
health.missing_or_invalid_field: A required field is missing or has an unsupported type; the record is incomplete evidence.
health.oversized_line: The event line exceeded the parsing limit and was skipped.
health.malformed_json: The event line is not a supported JSON object and was skipped.
health.unsupported_schema: The source schema version is unsupported; the event was skipped.
health.unexpected_action: The event is not a supported notification event and was skipped.
health.unsupported_event: The event type is outside the current monitoring scope and was skipped.
health.relative_file_path: The system file path is relative; directory association is unknown.
health.path_truncated: The path is truncated or its integrity is unknown; it cannot establish a complete directory association.
health.archive_input_source_unknown: The command has no parseable direct input; the source of standard input or implicit input is unknown.
health.archive_arguments_incomplete: Archive arguments are outside the supported forms. Input paths were not inferred.
health.archive_input_list_unsupported: The command uses a list file or indirect input. The list was not read and paths were not inferred.
health.archive_output_state_capacity: Archive output correlation reached its memory limit; some associations may be missing.
health.process_state_capacity: Process correlation reached its memory limit. Oldest states were removed; some associations may be missing.
health.read_path_missing: The open or mapping event has no file path; directory association cannot be established.
health.readability_unknown: The open or mapping has no readable-permission evidence.
health.file_type_unknown: The file type is unknown; the path is only an access indicator.
health.path_not_absolute: The path is not an absolute path that can reliably establish directory boundaries.
health.file_state_capacity: File counting reached its memory limit; bulk access coverage may have gaps.
health.alert_state_capacity: Alert merge state reached its memory limit; subsequent evidence may generate a new alert.
